changes.comment: Add toCacheRequest(composition, hints) building an AiAssist.IAiCacheRequest breakpoint plan from a resolved composition's per-section effective stability, now exposed as IPromptSection.effectiveStability. Add IPromptSafetyPolicy.antiJailbreakPrefaceStability (defaults to 'frozen', resolving OQ-7) and fix the C2 checkThreshold defect where a chars===0 section could count toward the measured cacheable-prefix total depending on its position (design.md §5.1b; TECH_DEBT.md). C3 of ai-assist-prompt-caching.
